title: On Quantifying Literals in Boolean Logic and Its Applications to Explainable AI
reasoning: The paper is a technical work on Boolean logic and its computational applications. While it touches upon 'decision bias,' which is an ethical topic, it analyzes it from a purely formal and algorithmic standpoint. It does not engage with ethical theories, moral frameworks, or religious concepts. It provides tools to detect bias, not to evaluate the ethics of a situation in a broader sense.
